constraints: charSet accepts either a standard character-set name string (e.g. "ISO-8859-1", "UTF-8") or its numeric MIBEnum identifier; several names can map to the same MIBEnum (aliases).
The produced BLOB can subsequently be read back with the Convert to text command.

overloadMerges.note: convertedBLOB receives the conversion result (documented as returned in this BLOB); corrected direction from 'in' to 'out'.

params.name: 4Dtext
params.description: Text expressed in the current character set of 4D

params.name: charSet
params.description: Name (string) or MIBEnum number (integer) of the character set to convert to

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Converts a 4D Unicode text into another character set and returns the converted bytes as a BLOB.
